DICETHESPIRECORE-BUMP.description: Upgrade the card if possible, otherwise create an unupgraded copy.
DICETHESPIRECORE-BUMP.title: Bump
DICETHESPIRECORE-RUMMAGE.description: Discard a chosen number of cards. Draw that many.
DICETHESPIRECORE-RUMMAGE.title: Rummage
DICETHESPIRECORE-REROLL.description:
Randomize the cost of a card between 0 and 3 this turn.
Some exceptions apply
DICETHESPIRECORE-REROLL.title: Reroll
DICETHESPIRECORE-NUDGE.description: Downgrade the card if possible, otherwise [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the card.
DICETHESPIRECORE-NUDGE.title: Nudge
DICETHESPIRECORE-INSPECT.description: Look at the top {Cards} cards of the draw pile. You may [gold]Blink[/gold] any of them.
DICETHESPIRECORE-INSPECT.title: Inspect
DICETHESPIRECORE-HELD.description: At the end of your turn, if this card is held in hand, this card triggers an effect.
DICETHESPIRECORE-HELD.title: Held
DICETHESPIRECORE-RANGE.oneDescription: This card will always randomize to cost [blue]{cost}[/blue].
DICETHESPIRECORE-RANGE.twoDescription: This card will always randomize to cost between [blue]{min}[/blue] and [blue]{max}[/blue].
DICETHESPIRECORE-RANGE.title: Range [{values}]
DICETHESPIRECORE-FLIP.description:
Inverse the cost of a card until the next time it is played this turn.
Cards that cost 3+, cost 0.
Cards that cost 2, cost 1.
Cards that cost 1, cost 2.
Cards that cost 0, cost 3.
DICETHESPIRECORE-FLIP.title: Flip
